'''Keal Roscon''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and was a member of [[The Shield]] around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. He was also secretly a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Biography==
Keal began his career with the [[Sullustan Home Guard/Legends|Sullustan Home Guard]], but his situation was short-lived as he could not keep himself out of trouble while he was off-duty. He left his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and found employment with a number of other transportation corporations before meeting [[Peert Ginzork]] and signing on with [[The Shield]]. The Shield was a private security company that was secretly a front for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="CRO" />

==Personality and traits==
Roscon was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] known for his daring (and somewhat suicidal) tactics. He was a quiet one, unless the subject of space travel came up, in which case he became very excited and began to endlessly relay tales about famed [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and pilots.<ref name="CRO" />

==Skills and abilities==
Roscon was a decent pilot for both space [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and archaic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. He was also skilled at [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] and operating ship's [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. He was an experienced spacer and was a decent combatant with both [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and brawling.<ref name="CRO" />

==Equipment==
Roscon carried a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] that had a hair trigger on it. He also wore a [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]] and carried a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]], a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and a micronite [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive charge]].<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Keal Roscon was designed by [[Rick Olshak]] for ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1994]]. He was illustrated by [[Mike Vilardi]].
